weapons.name: AWS .308 Winchester subsonic
weapons.source_note: Accuracy International's own AW system configurator lists: '.308 Suppressed* 16" 1 in 9 N/A 4 No 2560' with footnote '*The Suppressed unit consists of a 16" barrel housed in a suppressor of 28" overall length. It is designed to shoot both subsonic and full power ammunition.' This is the maker's figure for the suppressed .308 AW (AWS) barrel: 1 turn in 9 inches (228.6 mm), 4 grooves. Note the standard .308 AW barrel is listed separately as 1 in 12.

weapons.name: AR-7 Semi-auto Survival Rifle
weapons.source_note: Henry Repeating Arms (the current manufacturer of the AR-7 design, sold as the H2 U.S. Survival Rifle) spec table states: 'Rate of Twist 1:16' for all .22 LR models (H002B/H002C/H002VWP). 1 turn in 16 inches = 406.4 mm.

weapons.name: Colt Combat Commander 4.25" .45 ACP
weapons.source_note: Dealer product listing for the exact model, quoting the factory description: 'Colt presents the CLT Combat Commander 45ACP 4.25 SS ... a robust .45 ACP caliber, and a 4.25-inch steel barrel with 1:16 left hand twist and 6 groove rifling.' 1 turn in 16 inches = 406.4 mm. Colt does not publish twist on colt.com, so this is a dealer listing of the factory specification, corroborated by the standard 1911 .45 ACP rate (1:16 LH).
